p1.coverage:
p1: tiers (site orbits k, bond orbits n) searched in order; complete: (1,1), (1,2), (1,3), (1,4), (1,5), (1,6), (2,1), (2,2), (2,3), (2,4), (2,5), (2,6), (3,2), (3,3), (3,4), (3,5), (3,6).
Bounds: bond orbits with a bond at most 1 primitive cell(s) long in each direction for some position of the generating points; at most 6 bond orbits (lattices with more bond orbits for the same k are NOT covered); every site >= 3 bonds; planarity tested at 256 random site-parameter samples per configuration (seed 0): a planar window missed by every sample is not found.
Sheet rule: only choices of sites whose points alone have exactly the symmetry of the group were used (tested at 3 random parameter values each).
No rank gap: below the stopping tier no configuration allows more than max_bond_orbits bond orbits (planarity bound).

tiers.note: k site orbits need >= k - 1 bond orbits to be connected
